notes: The MLP re-run exists to test whether the logistic-head conclusions were an artefact of a two-parameter, almost-convex model.
Every family is retuned for the MLP by the same rule as everywhere else (examples/optimizers-mlp-sweep.json: 24 trials, lowest final training loss, ties to the smaller value).
Target 0.147 is reachable by every arm (slowest floor ~0.1449) and sits near it, so the metric measures convergence progress rather than the first step.

Seed-7 numbers are a regression baseline, not evidence: over 10 seeds momentum averages ~7 epochs, AdaGrad and Adam are several times slower and Adam is not the fastest in either model. See runs/mlp-verified/optimizers/seed-sweep-summary.md; the tuned rates come from runs/optimizers-mlp-tuning (lowest final training loss per family, ties to the smaller value).
